title: Pet Your Dog
description: Pet your tamed dogs! Press F to pet your dog and watch hearts fly.
body:
![Pet Your Dog 🐾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62f1bfe768fd8fadb4f5705d6ca92c18507a3581.jpeg)

A fun Minecraft 1.16.5 Forge mod that lets you pet your tamed dogs!

## Features
- **Press F** while looking at your tamed dog to pet it
- **Custom Animation**: Your camera smoothly moves to look at the dog while your hand reaches out
- **Heart Particles**: Hearts burst from the dog's head showing it's happy
- **Head Tilt**: The dog tilts its head adorably while being petted
- **Happy Sounds**: The dog makes happy sounds when petted
- **Cooldown**: 2-second cooldown prevents spam
- **Multiplayer Ready**: Other players can see when you pet your dog

## Installation
1. Install Minecraft Forge for 1.16.5
2. Download the mod JAR file
3. Place it in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## How to Use
1. Tame a wolf with bones
2. Look at your dog
3. Press **F** to pet it!
4. Watch the hearts fly and your dog react happily
